verdict.rationale: The API's own features include a managed Codex agent harness where OpenAI handles session orchestration, context compaction and recovery, plus a Batch API for asynchronous jobs with a 24-hour turnaround. Together these show agents can run tasks and work can be processed in the background, but only as one-off asynchronous jobs, not recurring automations. missing for 10: recurring schedules or triggers for automations, a documented background-run/automation setup flow, monitoring of autonomous runs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Build agents with a managed Codex harness while OpenAI handles session orchestration, context compaction, and recovery.
send asynchronous groups of requests with 50% lower costs, a separate pool of significantly higher rate limits, and a clear 24-hour turnaround time
Agents can plan and complete tasks using tools, work with other agents, and maintain context across steps.
